subject: MAP & Pilot Eval: PicoHealth — roadmap, pricing stack, and bundling options
messages:
From: Ava Turner <ava.turner@picohealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dr. Samuel Green <samuel.green@picohealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot request + MAP idea

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers looked promising. We want to run a short pilot tied to a MAP so we can: 1) validate inference quality on our triage flows, 2) measure cost at scale for our burst patterns, and 3) evaluate retention/observability tradeoffs for compliance.

High-level asks from PicoHealth:
- 3–4 week technical pilot (non-prod) starting mid-Feb, with sample traffic from our triage app
- MAP with clear success criteria for go/no-go (latency P95, accuracy on 5 evaluation prompts, token cost target)
- Pricing guidance if we move to a committed Dedicated plan after the pilot (we may need an accelerated ramp)
- Options for extended observability retention (HIPAA-adjacent analytics) and premium support SLAs

Can you send a proposed MAP + a pricing sketch we can review with procurement/legal? If useful, Jordan from Health-Legal is willing to take a first pass on data handling language.

Best,
Ava

Subject: RE: Pilot request + MAP idea

Hi Ava / Sam / Jordan —

Really appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a draft MAP (PicoHealth_MAP_v3.pdf) and a pricing rundown spreadsheet. Key points up front so your team can react quickly:

Summary (proposal)
- Pilot: 4-week technical pilot (non-prod) — target start: week of Feb 16. Deliverables: test harness, sample traffic runbook, weekly syncs.
- Evaluation gates (MAP milestones):
  * M1 (end of week 1): integration complete, can replay 10k real messages
  * M2 (end of week 2): P95 latency <= 250ms on 95% of samples + baseline quality pass on seed prompts
  * M3 (end of week 4): cost-per-1k-tokens benchmark + formal sign-off for production pilot
- Commercial optics: pricing tiers tied to committed ramp after pilot: 3-month ramp schedule (month1: 30% of committed baseline, month2: 65%, month3: 100%) — see Pricing_Rundown.xlsx for dollar examples.
- Discounting: conditional discounts applied once signed committed term is executed within 30 days of pilot sign-off: 8% off list for 12-month commit; incremental 5% (total 13%) if PicoHealth commits to the Dedicated bundle + 365-day observability retention add-on.
- Bundles/add-ons considered: 365-day observability retention (Optimize Plus), Premium Support (SLA & 24/7 on-call), and one-time onboarding credits (8 hours of expert tuning).

Next steps
1) Confirm pilot start date (we penciled Feb 16)
2) Team to review MAP + pricing and flag any hard constraints from legal/procurement (Jordan)
3) If you’re comfortable, we’ll lock in the conditional commercial terms and ship an SOW draft for signature.

I’ll loop in Rishi (account lead) and Priyom (solutions/ops) for pricing and SOW.

Thanks,
Monica

Subject: Fwd: Pilot request + MAP idea — pricing / approval needed

Fwding Ava's ask and the MAP draft. High-level ask from me:
- Can we commit to the proposed discount structure (8% for 12mo + extra 5% for Dedicated+365d retention) as a negotiable concession?
- Can we include 50k observation credits (token/insight credits) as a sweetener during the pilot if they sign the SOW within 2 weeks of pilot close?
- Priyom — need confirmation on support hours and whether 365d retention requires double-storage pricing or if we can offer it as a packaged add-on.

Timeline: we want internal sign-off by EOD Wed 18 Feb so I can send the commercial MAP back to PicoHealth on Thu.

Notes: procurement may push for faster ramp (they want production SLA month2). I'm inclined to keep ramp protections but offer an SLA bridge for month2 if they agree to a higher commit level.

Thoughts?
Monica

--
Monica

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot request + MAP idea — pricing / approval needed

Monica —
Agree with the structure, proposing the following tweaks we can safely approve without exec escalation:
- Immediate commercial: offer 6% near-term discount (applies on signing SOW within 14 days of pilot end).
- Post-ramp discounts: incremental 6% once they reach full committed baseline (resulting total 12% for 12mo commit + Dedicated bundle). We keep the extra 5% (to 17%) as an okay-to-negotiate uplift if they also commit to a minimum annual spend of $150k.
- Observability retention: convert to a named bundle (Optimize Plus) priced as a single line item rather than raw storage costs — makes procurement easier. For the pilot we can include 90-day retention at no charge; 365-day is an add-on priced in Pricing_Rundown.xlsx.
- Credits/onboarding: approve 50k observation credits + 8 hours onboarding as part of pilot close.
- SLA bridge: offer a 30-day SLA bridge (trial SLA) if they agree to accelerate ramp to 75% in month2.

I attached an updated Pricing_Rundown.xlsx with the above reflected. If Priyom confirms tech feasibility for 365-day retention and the SLA bridge, I’ll sign off.

Rishi

Attaching the consolidated MAP (PicoHealth_MAP_v3.pdf) and the pricing stack we discussed. Below is a concise summary of what Redwood is proposing to keep things actionable. If this looks good we’ll convert the MAP into an SOW and route for signature.

Consolidated commercial summary

- Conditional commercial terms:
  * Pilot close -> sign SOW within 14 days -> immediate 6% discount on committed baseline
  * Full ramp achieved -> additional 6% discount (total 12% for standard 12mo commit + Dedicated bundle)

  * Premium Support (SLA + 24/7 pager) — configurable per-term
  * One-time onboarding: 8 hours expert tuning + 50k observation credits (applied to pilot metrics collection)
- SLA bridge: 30-day trial SLA can be provided if PicoHealth accelerates ramp to 75% in month2.

Requested action items
1) Please confirm the MAP and the conditional commercial terms by Thu, Feb 26 so we can turn this into an SOW and reserve the Dedicated nodes.
2) Jordan — any data-handling redlines we should anticipate for the SOW?
3) Ava / Sam — confirm pilot start and whether you want the 90-day retention free option or to include 365-day Optimize Plus during pilot (pricing difference is in the spreadsheet).

We’re prepared to start the pilot as soon as we get your nod. Thanks for the partnership and clear priorities — aiming to make this as low-friction as possible for your procurement team.
